name: Guacamole
description: Remote consoles: a terminal/console on every machine that has a Guacamole connection, opened through an audited lab route (owner; admins only with a time-limited grant the owner approves), active session counts. Through the guacamole connector (read-only Guacamole user); the console signs in with the viewer's own Guacamole account.

fields.label: Guacamole URL
fields.help: as the lab host reaches it (the REST API is under /api)

fields.label: Service user
fields.help: READ on the connections, no system permissions

fields.label: Public URL
fields.help: where browsers open consoles (empty = the URL above)

fields.label: Admins may ask for terminals
fields.help: off: consoles are owner-only. on: an admin asks the owner (approval) and gets one machine for the minutes below

settings.label: connection name → object id
settings.help: For connections whose name doesn't say which lab object they are: "cisco vwlc=vwlc810" (comma-separated). A "(CT 112)" hint in the name already maps to that guest.
